about: Files under lib/ that still call DateTimeInterface::diff() themselves instead of asking Service/Time/DayCount. An entry names the open change that takes the file and says why it is not taken yet. DayCountIsTheOnlyDiffTest fails on a file that is not listed, on an entry without a change or a reason, and on an entry whose file no longer calls diff(), so the list can only shrink.
